title: 🏛️ Exam 2024 · reading: lost at the mall ⭐⭐

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) From the text: "Then, Alex went to the funzone to play and Mrs William had coffee with some friends." Complete the paragraph: "When Alex enjoyed his time at the ___, his mother sat by the window of a shop and had some ___."
questions.explanation: The text says that Alex went to the funzone to play and that his mother had coffee: the blanks are funzone and coffee. The toyshop is where Alex went earlier to see the skateboard, and the friends are the people she was with, not what she had to drink.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) From the text: "Last week, Mrs William drove her son Alex to the mall for shopping." How did Alex and his mother go to the mall?
questions.explanation: To drive is to take a car, so Mrs William took her son to the mall by car. The text never says that they took a bus or a taxi, and a mother who drives does not walk.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) From the text: "He explained that he went to the toyshop to see the skateboard he wished to buy." Why did Alex leave the clothes shop?

options.text: He was scared and wanted to go home.
He wanted to see a skateboard in the toyshop.
He wanted to have a coffee with his mother's friends.
He wanted to find a lovely dress at a good price.

questions.explanation: Alex explained to his mother that he went to the toyshop to see the skateboard that he wished to buy. The text does not say that he was scared or that he wanted a coffee, and the lovely dress is what his mother found, not what Alex was looking for.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) From the text: "Later, Alex returned and apologized to his mother. [...] His mother advised him not to go anywhere alone next time." Who does the word "him" refer to?

options.text: a kid playing in the funzone

questions.explanation: The person who is advised is Alex: his mother is the one who gives the advice, so "him" cannot be her. The noun that comes just before a pronoun is not always the one it replaces, and neither a kid in the funzone nor a shopkeeper is named in these sentences.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) From the text: "But Alex left the shop. Mrs William was scared. She couldn't find him." What does "scared" mean?
questions.explanation: Mrs William could not find her son, so she was afraid: scared means afraid. Angry, tired and happy do not fit a mother who cannot find her child.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) A friend says: "Alex went to the toy shop without his mother's permission." According to this part of the text, which comment is correct? "She went to the fitting room to try it on and asked Alex to wait for her. But Alex left the shop."

options.text: False: Alex told his mother, and she said yes.
True: Alex wanted to buy a new skateboard in the toy shop of the mall.
True: his mother asked him to wait, but he left the shop.
False: Mrs William went with him to the toy shop.

questions.explanation: Mrs William asked her son to wait for her, and he left anyway: he went without her permission. The wish to buy a skateboard explains why he left, but it does not prove that he had no permission, and nothing in the text says that his mother agreed or went with him.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2024) Is the statement "Mrs William bought a new skateboard for Alex." true or false, and why? The text says: "Looking from the window, she saw Alex watching a kid playing with his skateboard. 'It will be his next birthday gift,' she said."

options.text: True: she says that the skateboard will be his next birthday gift.
True: Alex went to the toy shop and his mother paid for the new skateboard there.
False: the skateboard belongs to Alex's cousin.
False: the skateboard will be a gift later, so she has not bought it yet.

questions.explanation: Mrs William says that the skateboard will be his next birthday gift: she plans to give it later, so she has not bought it yet. A will sentence is a plan, not a past action, and nothing in the text says that she paid for a skateboard or that the skateboard belongs to a cousin.
